Pet Cancer Therapy
(Surgery and Chemotherapy)
As overwhelming as a cancer diagnosis for your pet may be, know that we at
Aurora Animal Hospital
are here to support your family with comprehensive pet cancer therapy, including surgery and chemotherapy, in Fairbanks, AK.
Request Appointment
Pet Cancer Therapy (Surgery and Chemotherapy) at Aurora Animal Hospital in Fairbanks, AK
Our compassionate
veterinary team
offers expert pet cancer therapy, including surgery and chemotherapy, to provide the best possible care for your beloved companion. Located in Fairbanks, AK, we are dedicated to helping pets live healthier, more comfortable lives through tailored treatment plans and ongoing support.
When to Consider Pet Cancer Therapy
Recognizing the signs of cancer early is essential for effective treatment. Common symptoms include lumps or masses, unexplained weight loss, difficulty eating, lethargy, or changes in behavior. If you notice any of these symptoms, scheduling an evaluation with our team is crucial. In some cases, your primary veterinarian may refer you to Aurora Animal Hospital for advanced pet cancer therapy, such as surgery or chemotherapy. Whether your pet requires treatment for a newly diagnosed condition or ongoing management, we are here to help.
Benefits of Pet Cancer Therapy

Improved Quality of Life
Cancer therapy reduces pain and discomfort, enabling pets to enjoy their daily activities and spend more meaningful time with their families.

Extended Lifespan
Treatments like surgery and chemotherapy can slow disease progression, giving pets more time to share special moments with their loved ones.

Symptom Management
Therapy addresses symptoms such as weight loss, fatigue, or mobility issues, helping pets feel more comfortable and supported throughout their journey.

Targeted Treatment Plans
Tailored approaches ensure the therapy meets your pet’s unique needs, maximizing effectiveness while minimizing potential side effects.
What Is Pet Cancer Therapy?
Pet cancer therapy involves a range of treatments designed to manage and combat cancer in animals. At
Aurora Animal Hospital
, we focus on two primary approaches: surgery and chemotherapy.
Surgery
This method aims to remove cancerous tumors and affected tissue, reducing the disease’s progression. Surgical intervention may be used as a standalone treatment or in combination with other therapies.
Chemotherapy
Chemotherapy uses medications to target and destroy cancer cells, helping to control the spread of the disease. It is often recommended for cancers that cannot be fully addressed through surgery alone.
Schedule Your Pet’s Cancer Therapy Today
If your pet has been diagnosed with cancer, don’t wait to explore your treatment options. Our
veterinary team
is here to provide the care and support your pet needs during this challenging time. Take the first step toward giving your pet a healthier, more comfortable life. Schedule an
appointment
with
Aurora Animal Hospital
today.

Aurora Animal Hospital, locally owned and operated since 1975, proudly provides comprehensive veterinary care to the companion animal and sled dog communities of interior Alaska. Conveniently located on College Road in Fairbanks, Alaska, across from Creamer’s Field, we offer a full range of services for dogs, cats, pocket pets, birds, and reptiles.

Our experienced veterinarians bring expertise in various areas, including orthopedics, dermatology, ophthalmology, oncology, rehabilitation, and more, and we can facilitate referrals to specialists both in and out of state when necessary.
